query_snapshot: How does NBS Circular 592 contrast Type 304 stainless steel's behavior in nitric acid with its behavior in sulfuric acid when discussing 2 N mixed acids?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- In 2 N mixed acids (ranging from 2 N HNO3 to 2 N H2SO4), Type 304 stainless steel is immune to nitric acid. [nbscircular592.pdf, p. 60, chunk 2b809bc1]
- In 2 N mixed acids (ranging from 2 N HNO3 to 2 N H2SO4), Type 304 stainless steel is susceptible to sulfuric acid. [nbscircular592.pdf, p. 60, chunk 2b809bc1]
